QF.id: XXVA Regulatory Compliance for Non-Core Research Personnel_11

question.text: Under the RA Regulations, with respect to securities they recommend or follow, research analysts must NOT trade in those securities during which window around publication of a research report?

answer.text: Seven days before and one day after publication
Thirty days before and five days after publication of the research report
Fifteen days before and fifteen days after publication
Only on the day of publication

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that under the RA Regulations, analysts must not trade in securities they recommend or follow within thirty days before and five days after publication of a research report. The research entity is expected to put monitoring and control procedures in place to enforce this restriction. The Trap: Shorter or symmetric windows (seven/one, fifteen/fifteen) and a day-of-publication-only restriction are not the rule stated in the workbook; the prescribed window is asymmetric — thirty days before and five days after. Note: The explanation stays within the source-supported pre- and post-publication trading restriction and the related monitoring obligation; no self-reporting or leniency claims are added.
